metrics.profile_summary: Results-driven Digital Marketing and Brand Strategist specializing in performance marketing and brand building. Expert in scaling eCommerce brands and optimizing ROI through data-driven, full-funnel strategies.

experience.description: Managed 360° nationwide marketing strategies, coordinating social media, performance, and influencer initiatives to align with launch calendars and sales targets.
Led full-funnel marketing across digital and retail channels, developing high-impact campaigns to improve brand visibility and customer acquisition.
Developed brand positioning, messaging frameworks, and data-driven content strategies focused on community growth and brand credibility.
Executed integrated eCommerce campaigns and optimized advertising budgets, reducing CPL by 30% through data-driven targeting.
Scaled ad campaigns with 10x ROI using Meta and Google Ads, focusing on brand building and performance marketing.

strengths: Strong technical proficiency in performance marketing (Meta, Google, TikTok)
Experience with consumer brands (Ndure, Tymo Beauty)
Proven ability to optimize ROI, CAC, and LTV
weaknesses: Does not meet the 5-7 year experience requirement (approx. 3 years)
No explicit mention of GA4 proficiency
Lack of clear evidence regarding people management duration
evaluation.summary: The candidate is technically strong in digital and performance marketing with relevant consumer brand experience. However, they lack the required seniority and proven people management experience requested for this Managerial role.
